postings.title: Account Executive (Dutch/French Speaking)
postings.description:
Outpost24 is hiring an Account Executive to join our growing team in Amsterdam, or Leuven!

Are you a results-driven Account Executive with 8–15+ years of experience selling complex cybersecurity solutions to Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies? Do you have, and are able to build, long-term C-suite relationships, lead large-ticket deal cycles, and drive revenue growth in highly competitive markets? Are you well-versed in the cybersecurity landscape, including threat intelligence, cloud security, network security, and compliance frameworks? Do you have a proven track record of consistently exceeding quotas and scaling go-to-market efforts in both established and emerging tech companies?

We’re particularly interested in candidates based in Amsterdam or Leuven, to stay close to key customer sites and collaborate effectively when needed.

If so, we would love to hear from you!

As an Account Executive your key responsibilities include:

- Drive end-to-end enterprise sales cycles for cybersecurity solutions including prospecting, solution positioning, negotiation, and closure

- Develop and execute strategic account plans for key enterprise clients, aligning cybersecurity solutions to their business and risk management goals

- Build relationships with C-level executives (CISOs, CIOs, CTOs) and key stakeholders to uncover pain points and promote solution value

- Apply solution selling and consultative selling methodologies to understand customer needs and tailor offerings accordingly

- Lead complex deal negotiations, often involving multiple stakeholders and long sales cycles

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure customer satisfaction and growth

- Partner with marketing to drive Account-Based Marketing (ABM) strategies that support targeted prospecting and engagement

- Manage and grow a healthy territory and pipeline, ensuring consistent forecasting and performance tracking

- Maintain expert-level knowledge of cybersecurity threats, trends, regulations and competitor offerings

- Forecast pipeline accurately using CRM tool (Salesforce) and adhere to enterprise sales methodologies (MEDDPIC, BANT)

- Follow established sales methodologies such as MEDDPIC and BANT to qualify and advance opportunities

- Participate in industry events, webinars, and forums to evangelize the brand and generate demand

What makes you our ideal candidate?

- 8-15+ years of experience in B2B/enterprise software sales, with at least 5+ years focused specifically on cybersecurity

- Proven success in consistently achieving or surpassing million-plus euro quotas

- Deep knowledge of cybersecurity domains including: Identity & Access Management, Attack Surface Management, Threat Intelligence & Digital Risk Protection, Vulnerability Management, Pen Testing & Red Teaming

- Strong understanding of security buyer personas and complex procurement processes

- Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills in English, Dutch or French

- A self-starter with a hunter mentality who is motivated by results.

- A strategic thinker who also executes tactically

- Demonstrates high emotional intelligence and executive presence

- Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and embraces change

- You’re based in Amsterdam, or Leuven or willing to be located there, to be close to our key customer sites and collaborate effectively when needed

But what’s in it for you?
In return for your efforts, we can offer you:

- A flat organizational structure and lots of autonomy; you are not just a number. You will join an organization that offers a steep learning curve, where your contributions will have a tangible impact

- The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing and fun European cybersecurity company

- A healthy work-life balance, so you can enjoy flexible work hours and a hybrid working environment if desired

- An opportunity to join our growing office and team in:

- Leuven: If you join our office in Leuven, you will have access to an office space that includes a lovely rooftop terrace in the summer, beverages, and occasional after work activities to enjoy with your colleagues.

- Amsterdam: You would be joining an amazing coworking space that includes beverages, snacks and barista service to enjoy with your coworkers.

And so much more!

Sounds like you? Then apply today!

Don’t fulfil all the criteria? At Outpost24, we're dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, where attitude, values, and willingness to learn are valued above all. So, if you're excited about this role but your professional experiences don't completely align with what we're looking for, we encourage you to apply anyway.

postings.title: AI Software Engineer
postings.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI Software Engineer to join our dynamic and collaborative development team in Stockholm, Karlskrona, Barcelona or Leuven!

As an AI Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in developing our core AI services within the cyber security domain, refining and adapting models, and enabling teams across the company to integrate AI into their products and workflows. This role blends hands‑on engineering with applied AI problem‑solving.

You will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects, leveraging the power of Python and Golang to build high-performance applications with cutting-edge cloud technologies. You might not already be fluent in both Python and Golang, but if you have the right mindset and fit for us, we will support you in managing both languages!

As an AI Software Engineer your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

- Develop AI solutions in Python, with supporting services in Golang.

- Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI services and APIs.

- Provide AI expertise, guidance, and troubleshooting support across the organization.

- Fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize machine learning and LLM-based models.

- Integrate AI capabilities into products and systems.

- Research and evaluate emerging AI technologies and best practices.

- Contribute to coding standards, architecture, and engineering best practices.

- Ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of AI-powered systems.

- Conduct code reviews and resolve software defects and performance issues.

What type of experience do we expect from our ideal candidate?

Must Have:

- 5+ years of professional software development experience.

- Strong proficiency in Python (or a similar language) commonly used for AI and machine learning development.

- Good understanding of machine learning fundamentals; practical experience with modern AI frameworks is highly valued.

- Hands-on experience working with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or model fine-tuning.

- Solid understanding of software engineering principles, including data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and system design.

- Experience building scalable, reliable, and maintainable software solutions.

- Proficiency with Git and modern version control practices.

- Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and collaborative engineering environments.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English.

- As a person you have strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapt to changing priorities.

Nice to Have:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience designing, deploying, or operating cloud-native and highly available systems, ideally using technologies such as Kubernetes.

- Experience with Amazon Bedrock or other AI platforms and providers such as Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS AI Services, or Google Vertex AI.

- Knowledge of or interest in cybersecurity and secure software development practices.

But what's in it for you?

In return for your efforts, we will offer you:

- A flat organizational structure and lots of autonomy; you are not just a number. You will join an organization that offers a steep learning curve, where your contributions will have a tangible impact.

- The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing and fun European cybersecurity company.

- Employees also benefit from regular performance conversations with their managers, focused on development, career progression, and self improvement.

- Join our team in one of our offices, and experience a workplace that’s as vibrant as the city, from fun socials, great perks, and a collaborative environment!

- A healthy work-life balance, so you can enjoy flexibility and a hybrid working environment (3 days in office).

And so much more!

At Outpost24, we're dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, where attitude, values and willingness to learn are valued above all. So, if you're excited about this role but your professional experiences don't completely align with what we're looking for, we encourage you to apply anyway!

postings.title: Experienced Ethical Hacker
postings.description:
Outpost24 is looking for an Experienced Ethical Hacker to join our growing team in Karlskrona!

Are you passionate about uncovering vulnerabilities, pushing the boundaries of security, and staying one step ahead of cyber threats? As an ethical hacker/Web application analyst, you will become part of Outpost24’s Ghost Labs team: Outpost24’s ethical hacking team, technically rooted and the core of Outpost24’s hacking activities. We perform all penetration tests, conduct security research and contribute to the security community through responsible disclosure and proof-of-concepts. Do you think that you’ve got what it takes, and would you like to join the Ghosts? Read on!

As IT Security Consultant in the Ghost Labs AppSec team, you are the backbone of our Application Security portfolio. You understand the capabilities as well as the limitations of automation. You offer the human knowledge needed to uncover vulnerabilities in our customers web applications.

Join us if you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on the security of web applications around the world.

As an Experienced Ethical Hacker your key responsibilities will include:

- Initial penetration testing (on-boarding) of customers web applications.

- Re-occurring penetration testing (re-tests) of the customers continuous monitored web applications.

- Mentoring junior team-members.

- Responding to customer inquiries.

- QA.

Further specialisation into a dedicated role, such as: Web application, infrastructure, exploitation, custom tools development, research and content generation.

What makes you our ideal candidate?

- As ethical hacker, you can think outside of the box and you understand to use your technical skills to improve the security of our customers. You are passionate for technology and security.

- You can work independently, but you are also a team player and always keen to keep exploring, developing and learning new things.

- 2+ years of experience with penetration testing and a strong drive to uncover vulnerabilities

- You have completed a relevant University (of applied sciences) degree, or have one or more relevant certifications such as: OSCP, OSCE, CISSP, GPEN, OSWE.

- You have extensive experience with IT Security experience, for example: Penetration testing web applications (including reporting and delivery).

- You are a true team player and self-claimed computer nerd.

- You have extensive programming/scripting and or network engineering skills.

- You are proficient in English and can communicate effectively, as this is our corporate language.

- You have a collaborative mindset combined with the ability to work independently.

But what’s in it for you?
In return for your efforts, we can offer you:

- A flat organizational structure and lots of autonomy; you are not just a number. You will join an organization that offers a steep learning curve, where your contributions will have a tangible impact

- An organizational culture founded on trust, respect, adaptability, and commitment, where your personal and professional development will be emphasized

- The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing and fun European cybersecurity company

- A healthy work-life balance, so you can enjoy flexible work hours and a hybrid working environment if desired

- An exciting opportunity to join us at our headquarters in Karlskrona or our vibrant Stockholm office - while enjoying the local perks and benefits of working in Sweden.

- We will support you in developing yourself and furthering your skills within the cyber security area. We help you evolve through fun off-site activities, Capture the flag events, trainings (on-site and remote), industry leading certifications, such as OSCP, OSWE and OSCE and work trips to conferences.

And so much more!

Sounds like you? Then apply today!

Don’t fulfil all the criteria? At Outpost24, we're dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, where attitude, values, and willingness to learn are valued above all. So, if you're excited about this role but your professional experiences don't completely align with what we're looking for, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Please note that only candidates with full, permanent working rights in Sweden can be considered for this position, as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship.

postings.title: Full Stack Developer
postings.description:
Outpost24 is seeking a skilled Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic and collaborative development team in Leuven!
In this role, you will design, build, and maintain robust and scalable full‑stack applications that power our cyber security solutions. You will work across the frontend using Angular and the backend using Python, ensuring both feature delivery and the long‑term maintainability, scalability, and architectural quality of our applications.

About us:
Outpost24 is a leading cyber assessment company focused on enabling our customers to achieve maximum value from their evolving technology investments. By leveraging our full stack security insights to reduce attack surface for any architecture, our customers continuously improve their security posture with the least effort. Over 2,000 customers in more than 40 countries around the world trust us to assess their devices, networks, applications, cloud and container environments and report compliance status for government, industry sector, or internal regulations.

As a Full Stack Developer your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Develop user‑friendly, responsive, and scalable UIs using Angular, with strong focus on frontend architecture, performance, and long‑term maintainability.

- Design, develop, and deploy efficient and maintainable Python backend services.

- Ensure clean, reusable, and testable code that follows best practices and coding standards.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

- Work closely with UX designers: follow design guidelines, validate user flows, and proactively propose improvements to usability, consistency, and user experience.

- Use AI‑assisted development tools, including critically review, refine, and take full ownership of generated code.

- Identify and troubleshoot software defects and performance issues.

- Participate in architectural discussions and propose innovative solutions to improve product quality and developer efficiency.

What type of experience do we expect from our ideal candidate?

Must Have:

- 5+ years of software development experience.

- Proficiency in a JavaScript framework (preferably Angular), including structured frontend architectures and scalable component/module design.

- Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.

- Experience working with databases (preferably PostgreSQL).

- Proficiency in version control systems (preferably Git) .

- Interested in AI-assisted development, with the ability to confidently review and take ownership of generated code.

- Strong communication and collaboration abilities in English, as a primary corporate language.

- As a person you are analytical, great at problem-solving and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment!

Nice to have have:

- Familiarity with messaging systems such as Kafka and/or RabbitMQ

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

- Interest in graphic design and UX design is a plus.

Above all, we want to see someone who is an awesome team player – for us, attitude is everything!

But what’s in it for you?

In return for your efforts, we can offer you:

- A flat organizational structure and lots of autonomy; you are not just a number.

- Work with a fun and distributed team across the world.

- We believe in a hybrid work environment where you mix office presence with remote work or full time in the office. Our new office at the vibrant Vaartkom in Leuven is just a short walk from the train station - easy to reach, and a great spot to grab coffee or lunch nearby.

postings.description:

Are you a strategic cybersecurity leader with deep MSSP expertise, a strong industry network, and a passion for building high-impact partnerships? Do you enjoy shaping go-to-market strategies, influencing business growth, and creating lasting value through a thriving partner ecosystem?

As MSSP Program Director, you will own and drive Outpost24's global MSSP strategy, helping expand our market presence through strategic relationships with leading Managed Security Service Providers. Working closely with executive leadership, you will play a key role in defining our partner vision, identifying new growth opportunities, and building a scalable ecosystem that drives long-term success.

This is a highly visible, business-critical role with the opportunity to influence strategy, engage with senior decision-makers across the cybersecurity industry, and make a lasting impact on Outpost24's continued growth. If you have a proven track record of developing successful partner programs, driving commercial outcomes, and building trusted executive relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

As an MSSP Program Director your key responsibilities will include:

- Own and drive the global MSSP strategy and program, aligned with Outpost24’s overall business objectives.

- Develop clear MSSP strategy plans, priorities, KPIs and execution frameworks across regions.

- Partner closely with Sales leadership and field sales teams to identify, prioritize and develop MSSP opportunities.

- Build strong relationships with key MSSPs and leverage your existing industry network to create new strategic opportunities.

- Work closely with Product Management to ensure MSSP requirements, market feedback, and partner needs are reflected in product strategy and roadmap discussions.

- Develop joint strategic plans with priority MSSP partners, including routes to market, target customers, solutions and growth opportunities.

- Create the framework, tools and enablement needed for Sales teams to successfully engage and grow MSSP relationships.

- Identify opportunities to increase recurring revenue, customer reach and platform adoption through the MSSP ecosystem.

- Establish and track program-level metrics including partner recruitment, pipeline contribution, revenue, activation and growth.

- Act as the global MSSP subject-matter expert and internal champion, bringing market and partner insights into Outpost24.

What makes you our ideal candidate? We are looking for someone with:

- 8+ years of proven experience in MSSP, MSP, cybersecurity channel.

- A strong and demonstrable network of MSSPs and cybersecurity service providers.

- Experience building or leading global MSSP programs and strategies.

- A track record of influencing revenue growth through strategic partnerships and ecosystems.

- Strong understanding of how MSSPs build their offerings, monetize services and make technology/vendor decisions.

- Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Product Management, Marketing and Executive Leadership.

As part of our team, you'll work alongside talented colleagues from across the globe while helping shape the future of a leading cybersecurity company!

postings.title: Principal Cyber Security Advisor
postings.description:
Outpost24 is hiring a Principal Cyber Security Advisor to join our growing team in Barcelona, Amsterdam, Leuven or Sweden (Stockholm, or Karlskrona)!

Do you want to help organisations stay ahead of evolving cyber threats while building trusted customer relationships and shaping security strategy at the highest level?

We're looking for a cybersecurity expert with a customer-first mindset, a passion for solving complex challenges, and the ability to influence stakeholders at every level. As a Principal Cyber Security Advisor, you'll combine deep technical expertise with a consultative approach, helping customers strengthen their security posture and achieve their business goals. If you thrive in a customer-facing environment, enjoy making a tangible impact, and want to play a key role in our customers' security journey, we'd love to hear from you!

As English is the primary language at Outpost24, we kindly ask that all application materials (including CV) be submitted in English. This ensures all members of the hiring team can fairly assess your application. Please note that applications submitted in other languages may be more difficult to review and may not be considered.

What will your key responsibilities be?

- Serve as the senior escalation point and trusted advisor for our most strategic and complex customer accounts.

- Lead end-to-end advisory engagements, partnering with executive stakeholders to communicate cyber risk, shape security strategy, and drive meaningful security outcomes.

- Provide expert guidance on risk remediation, security programme maturity, prioritisation, and alignment with industry and regulatory requirements.

- Facilitate Executive Business Reviews, translating technical findings into clear, actionable insights alongside technical, service delivery, and customer success teams.

- Navigate complex stakeholder environments, resolve cross-functional challenges, and confidently communicate difficult findings and recommendations at executive level.

- Contribute to the growth of the advisory practice through solution design, Statements of Work, commercial input, and identifying opportunities that create customer value.

- Mentor advisors while establishing best practices, frameworks, and standards that elevate the quality and consistency of advisory delivery within the Outpost24 Managed Services team.

- Drive the evolution of customer security programmes and advisory services, helping organisations strengthen their security posture and resilience over time.

What makes you our ideal candidate?

Industry Experience and Expertise:

- 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, ideally within a security advisory, consulting, managed services, or customer-facing technical role.

- Strong understanding of cybersecurity domains such as Vulnerability Management, Application Security, Cloud Security, Threat Intelligence, EASM, or related areas.

- Experience advising customers on security strategy, risk management, and security programme maturity.

- Ability to communicate complex security concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Customer & Senior Mindset:

- Proven experience building trusted relationships with customers, including executive-level stakeholders.

- A consultative mindset with the ability to influence decision-making and drive meaningful outcomes.

- Confidence navigating complex customer challenges and translating them into practical solutions.

Qualifications:

- Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential, as it is our corporate language. Additional European language skills are a plus.

- Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are considered an advantage.

- A degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred, but not a requirement.

What’s in it for you?

In return, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in a growing European cybersecurity company where your expertise, ideas, and leadership are valued.

- A high-impact role with real influence: Enjoy the autonomy to shape customer outcomes, contribute to the evolution of our advisory practice, and help drive the future direction of our services. With a flat organisational structure, you'll have the freedom to make decisions and see the direct impact of your work.

- A collaborative and ambitious environment: Join a passionate team of cybersecurity professionals who are committed to tackling complex security challenges and delivering exceptional value to customers.

- Growth and development opportunities: Be part of a fast-growing European cybersecurity leader where you'll have the opportunity to expand your expertise, influence strategic initiatives, and continue developing your career.

- A great place to work: Join one of our European hubs in Amsterdam, Leuven or Karlskrona and enjoy a vibrant, international culture, regular social events, and a supportive team environment that values both professional success and personal wellbeing.

And so much more!

Sounds like you? Then apply today!

Don’t fulfil all the criteria? At Outpost24, we're dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, where attitude, values, and willingness to learn are valued above all. So, if you're excited about this role but your professional experiences don't completely align with what we're looking for, we encourage you to apply anyway.

postings.description:
Outpost24 is looking for a creative and hands-on Product Marketing Manager to join our team in Europe!
You will translate complex cybersecurity products into clear, compelling MOFU and BOFU content that supports the full Outpost24 portfolio. You’ll turn technical detail, customer insight, and market trends into practical assets that help buyers evaluate our solutions and help Sales have stronger, more relevant conversations.

You’re naturally curious, independent, commercially minded, and comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Leadership. You bring clarity and structure to technical and commercial complexity, and you’re as confident shaping a content narrative as you are producing the assets that bring it to life - from solution guides and comparison pages to sales decks, battlecards, webinars, customer stories, and campaign-supporting content.

You will work on a hybrid basis, spending 2-3 days per week in the office, from one our locations:

- United Kingdom (London or Plymouth)

- Sweden (Stockholm)

- Spain (Barcelona)

- Netherlands (Amsterdam)

Your key responsibilities will include:

- Drive content strategy for MOFU and BOFU stages - identifying content gaps across the Outpost24 portfolio and creating clear, compelling assets that support buyer evaluation, sales conversations, and pipeline progression.

- Translate positioning and messaging into practical content - turning value propositions, personas, use cases, and competitive differentiation into web copy, solution briefs, comparison assets, guides, webinars, analyst-ready narratives, and sales enablement materials.

- Create high-impact sales enablement - including pitch decks, battlecards, objection-handling guides, demo narratives, discovery questions, talk tracks, competitive leave-behinds, and assets that help Sales explain value clearly across different buyer needs and portfolio areas.

- Drive insight across the organisation - gathering and distilling customer feedback, market trends, and competitive intelligence into clear guidance for product direction and GTM strategy.

- Measure and improve content effectiveness - tracking how MOFU and BOFU assets are used by Sales and Marketing, gathering feedback on what works, and continuously improving content quality, relevance, and commercial impact.

- Work with pace and autonomy in a fast-moving, agile environment - delivering high-quality outputs quickly and reliably.

What makes you’re an ideal candidate?

- 5+ years of B2B Product Marketing experience in cybersecurity, with a strong track record of creating content and enablement for complex technical products.

- A track record of planning and producing high-quality MOFU and BOFU content that supports buyer education, product differentiation, and sales conversations.

- A clear, concise writer who can turn technical detail into compelling portfolio content, from solution messaging and explainer copy to sales enablement assets and buyer-facing materials.

- Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to turn portfolio messages into clear webinars, sales decks, customer-facing narratives, and enablement materials.

- Ability to move fast and work independently in a fast-paced, agile environment.

- A collaborative approach with Product, Sales, CS, and Marketing.

This job description is a wish list for our next hire, but we don’t necessarily expect our next hire to hit all the marks in every category. If you’re reading this description and are excited about the prospect of working in this role, you should apply!

But what's in it for you?

In return for your efforts, we will offer you:

- At Outpost24, you'll join a company where your ideas, contributions, and development truly matter. We're growing quickly, but we've worked hard to maintain a collaborative, down-to-earth culture where people are empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and challenge the status quo. As part of our team, you'll work alongside talented colleagues from across the globe while helping shape the future of a leading cybersecurity company.

- The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing and fun European cybersecurity company.

- A healthy work-life balance, so you can enjoy flexible work hours and a hybrid working environment (2-3 days in office).

- Employees also benefit from regular performance conversations with their managers, focused on development, career progression, and self improvement.

- Join our team in one of our European office, and experience a workplace that’s as vibrant as the city, from fun socials, great perks, and a collaborative environment!

And that's just the beginning! We believe great people do their best when they feel trusted, supported, and excited about what they do, and that's exactly the kind of environment we're building at Outpost24.

Sounds like you? Then apply today!
Don’t fulfil all the criteria? At Outpost24, we're dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, where attitude, values, and willingness to learn are valued above all. So, if you're excited about this role but your professional experiences don't completely align with what we're looking for, we encourage you to apply anyway.

postings.title: Senior Security Consultant
postings.additional_locations: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Barcelona, Spain; Stockholm, Sweden; Leuven, Belgium; Berlin, Germany
postings.description:
Outpost24 is looking for a Senior Security Consultant!

You will join our Offensive Security team within Ghost Labs in Europe (Karlskrona, Stockholm, Barcelona, Amsterdam, or Leuven).

The team consists of experienced ethical hackers who work across a wide range of offensive security engagements. As a Senior Security Consultant, you will play a key role in delivering advanced security assessments, simulating real-world attack scenarios, and helping our customers understand and reduce their risk.

You will work across different environments and technologies, including cloud platforms, applications, and emerging areas such as AI-driven systems.

As a Senior Security Consultant, your key responsibilities will include:

- Delivering offensive security engagements, including penetration testing and advanced red team engagements, leveraging frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and TIBER-EU/DORA

- Identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities across a wide range of environments and technologies

- Supporting complex security assessments that require creative and non-standard approaches

- Collaborating with team members on challenging scenarios and actively contributing to knowledge sharing

- Contributing to the continuous improvement of our tools, methodologies, and overall offensive security capabilities

As our ideal candidate, you:

- Have 5+ years of hands-on experience in offensive security (red teaming and/or penetration testing)

- Have a strong technical background and a practical understanding of how attackers operate in real-world scenarios. You are comfortable working across different domains and adapting your approach based on the target and objectives

- Have a strong understanding of modern attack techniques and methodologies

- Are experienced working with cloud environments and modern applications

- Can identify and chain vulnerabilities into meaningful attack scenarios

- Have scripting or programming experience

- Have a curious mindset and a passion for security

- Are a team player who is also comfortable working independently when needed

- Speak fluent English, as this is our corporate language

Ideally, you also have experience or interest in:

- AI/LLM security

- Mobile application testing

- Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, or equivalent certifications demonstrating advanced offensive security skills)

- Programming in Python, C, C++, or C#

But what’s in it for you?

In return for your efforts, you will enjoy:

- Working on a variety of offensive security engagements across different domains

- Being part of a skilled and collaborative team within Ghost Labs

- Opportunities to grow through hands-on experience, training, and certifications

- A flat organizational structure with high autonomy. You are not just a number. You will join an organization that offers a steep learning curve, where your contributions have a tangible impact

- A healthy work-life balance, with flexible working hours and a hybrid working environment

- An exciting opportunity to join our team in one of our EU Hubs (Karlskrona, Stockholm, Barcelona, Amsterdam, or Leuven), while enjoying the local perks and benefits of working in your chosen country!

Like what you see and want to know more? Apply now!

Recruitment Process

The recruitment process for this role will include:

- Screening Interview (10-20 minutes) - An introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition team.

- Technical Interview (1 hour) - A discussion with the hiring team focused on your technical knowledge and experience.

- Hands-On Security Assessment (1 hour) - A practical, task-based assessment designed to evaluate your security expertise through real-world scenarios. You'll receive access to a lab environment up to one week in advance, giving you time to complete the exercise. During the interview, you'll walk us through your findings, methodology, and thought process with the team.

At Outpost24, we're dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, where attitude, values and willingness to learn are valued above all. So, if you're excited about this role but your professional experiences don't completely align with what we're looking for, we encourage you to apply anyway!
